articles.title: Groups seek clarity on motive behind Pentagon’s study of women in combat
articles.summary: Citing concerns about Hegseth’s views on the topic, the lawsuit asks for records showing the scope, purpose, methodology and anticipated use of the study.

articles.title: Navy Medicine Sailors return home from deployment
articles.summary: An elite, far-forward Navy Medicine surgical asset returned to U.S. soil on Oct. 17, 2026, touching down at the military air terminal at Naval Air Station Norfolk following a seven-month deployment to the U.S. Central Command (CENTCOM) area of responsibility.

articles.title: US Army Cyber Command charts course for human-AI equilibrium
articles.summary: U.S. Army Cyber Command is constantly refining human oversight of artificial intelligence, Lt. Gen. Christopher Eubank said last week.

articles.title: SETAF-AF joins G-TEAD, USAREUR-AF at AUSA to explain how operational challenges in Africa drive tactical solutions
articles.summary: WASHINGTON – The U.S. Army Southern European Task Force, Africa (SETAF-AF) commander outlined how Africa is where operational problems are defined, solutions are tested in realistic conditions, and results are shared across the Army during the 2026 Association of the United States Army Annual Meeting and Exposition at the Walter E.

articles.title: Readout of U.S. Naval Forces Central Command/U.S. 5th Fleet/Combined Maritime Forces Vice Adm. Curt Renshaw's Meeting with Kuwaiti Defense Leaders
articles.summary: TAMPA, Fla. (Oct. 19, 2026) U.S. Naval Forces Central Command/U.S. 5th Fleet/Combined Maritime Forces Commander Vice Adm. Curt Renshaw met with key Kuwaiti political and defense leaders during a trip to Kuwait City, Kuwait, Oct. 18-19.

articles.title: US Army acquisition command awards contracts worth $6.8B in 2026
articles.summary: The Mission and Installation Contracting Command awarded 21,450 contracts in fiscal 2026 valued at $6.8 billion in total, a boost from the year prior.

articles.title: US Army showing interest in G/ATOR missile-killing radar, Northrop says
articles.summary: Northrop Grumman’s new multi-mission radar system has earned high marks from Marine Corps leadership. The U.S. Army has taken notice.

articles.title: A shifting landscape: Where the US Army moved in 2026 and what may be on the horizon
articles.summary: As seasons signal the waning months of 2026, the U.S. Army’s operational map continues to evolve.

articles.title: US Army fields new system for sweeping munitions planning, management
articles.summary: The service expects this first increment of TACTMIS to replace the previously used TAMIS system once it retires on Oct. 30.

articles.title: 86th IBCT (MTN) Relinquishes Command of JMTG-U
articles.summary: The Joint Multinational Training Group-Ukraine held a colors casing ceremony at the 7th Army Training Command headquarters on Oct. 15, 2026. Task Force Luzon, composed of the 86th Infantry Brigade Combat Team (Mountain) from the Vermont National Guard, cased its colors, relinquishing command responsibility for the mission.

articles.title: Passing the colors: Inigo gives final salute to 103rd Troop Command Soldiers
articles.summary: Col. Phoebe P. Inigo relinquished command of the 103rd Troop Command to Col. Byron Cadiz during a ceremony presided over by Brig. Gen. Ronald D. Hogsten, commander of the Hawaii Army National Guard. Inigo’s 22 months in command included responses to natural disasters, federal mobilizations and training with international partners.

articles.title: JMSDF Fleet Submarine Force Commander visits CTF-74
articles.summary: YOKOSUKA, Japan — Japan Maritime Self-Defense Force (JMSDF) Vice Adm. Noaya Hoshi, commander, Fleet Submarine Force, met with U.S. Navy Rear Adm. Gary Montalvo Jr., commander, Submarine Group 7 (CSG 7)/Task Force 74 (CTF 74) at Commander, Fleet Activities Yokosuka on Oct. 13, 2026.

articles.title: Connecticut National Guard hosts welcome home ceremony for 1-102nd Infantry
articles.summary: The Connecticut National Guard hosted a welcome home ceremony and Yellow Ribbon reintegration event for 1st Battalion, 102nd Infantry at the Gov. William A. O’Neill armory Oct. 17, 2026.
